data.body:
[P2] Isolate deferred export failures from parent scope setup

This drain runs inside `on_user_function_start`, before `_attach_context`. If a callback completed during suspension and its processor raises when replay registers the parent, `_render_operation_end` re-raises because `_finalization` is still `None`. Core contains the exception and executes the parent's body without attaching its OTel context, so user-created spans and correlated logs use the enclosing context. Later retries cannot repair their parentage. Contain ordinary failures per pending completion, retain retry state, and allow parent setup to finish; add a replay regression with a processor that fails once.
